issues.message: 1051 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
18 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.

notes.detail: Interior is furnished (council table with chairs, chests, clerks' desk in the tower, notice signs, back stair), but the outside has no window sills, shutters or lanterns; only torches.
notes.purpose: Reads as a civic hall with a tower, but the clock face at L1 is just a dark log end on plaster (looks like a small window), so 'town hall with clock' only comes with L2/L3.
notes.depth: Jetty brackets, corbelled tower ledge, dormers and the arcade arches give good shadows on the sides; the back face (stone ground floor, flat plaster gable) is plain.
notes.roof: Steep spruce roof with overhang, ridge slabs, dark oak barge trim and two side dormers; flared hip roof on the tower. Good.
notes.materials: Cobble plinth, stone bricks, dark oak frame, white terracotta infill, spruce roof: Style A, nothing clashing.
notes.shape: Tall front clock tower, raised hall over an open arcade, dormers: not a box.
notes.life: No plants, flowers or lanterns at L1 (by design: those come at L2/L3).
notes.scale: Big, but right for a landmark; tower 5x5 and 18 tall reads as a clock tower.
notes.levels: Three levels tell apart (banners and stalls at L2, flower boxes, bushes and benches at L3).

visual.summary: L1 is the shell: a half-timbered council hall on a stone market arcade with a stone clock tower and porch at the front, a furnished council chamber, clerks' office and back stair.
problems: Clock faces (log ends at x6 y13 z1, x4/x8 y13 z3) read as small dark windows at L1; consider a clearer clock disc (e.g. a ring of dark oak trapdoors or a white/terracotta dial around the log end) so the tower reads as a clock tower before L2.
Back face (z16-17) is flat: plain stone ground floor and a bare plaster gable; add a jetty, beam or small window/sill in the gable.
Hall windows (glass panes at x2/x10 y7) have no sills or shutters at any level.

Reachability: hall floor, arcade, tower clerks' office and back stair are reached; the tower clock chamber (floor y9, standing y10, x5..7 z2..4) has no ladder or stair and is unreached (not needed by soldiers, but it is a sealed room). Other unreached places are roof slopes, the tower ledge and the dormer tops: fine.
